## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: driving responsibilities
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The whole manual carries an old content-currency date (stated in part A), so any rule here may have changed since; the freshness debt in part A covers every fact in this section.
The points chart was extracted as rows of a value followed by a violation; selected rows were taught as printed, and two garbled rows about operating with or without the required license were not taught (verify TN-RESP-D-POINTS) [A03].
The text points readers to the points chart on a printed page number one lower than the page where the chart actually appears; the chart itself was used [A02].
Crash notice to police is stated with a property-damage threshold in one paragraph and without any threshold a few paragraphs later on the same page; the threshold version is taught (verify TN-RESP-D-NOTICE) [A05].
The study-question answer key printed at the end of this chapter covers every chapter's sample questions; no sample answer is taught as a fact [A06].
Department phone numbers, the mailing address and web addresses are contact details and are not taught.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.

verification_debt.claim_text: The points chart on physical page 101 was taught from extracted rows and two rows are garbled; confirm the current Tennessee point values for each violation from an official Department of Safety source.

Physical page 103 first requires immediate police notice for crashes with death, injury or property damage above a stated dollar amount, then says crashes involving any property damage, injury or death must be reported to police; confirm the current notice requirement.
